correctness.rationale: Direct integration over each shifted bin gives the displayed sine-difference formula. Averaging the origin tiles a full period and uses the exact integral of \(|\cos|\). For the aligned grid, division by \(g=\gcd(k,N)\) reduces the absolute-cosine sum to standard finite trigonometric sums in the three parity classes; their positivity leaves zeros only at reduced modulus one or two, exactly \(N\mid2k\). The special \(N=2k\) phase law follows by substitution.
risks: The result is population-level for one Fourier mode and equal-width circular bins; it does not establish finite-sample power.
